important_finding: This codebase currently implements a CONTEXT-WINDOW budget (how much text fits in one prompt), not a SPEND budget (a dollar/cost ceiling). No cost-ceiling or spend-limit enforcement of any kind was found in ai_generation.py, loop_engine.py, or agent_runs.py during this inspection. This fixture documents the context-window behavior precisely (real, testable) and explicitly marks spend-limit enforcement as ABSENT rather than fabricating a stop-at-$X mechanism that does not exist.
code_path: priority order P0 > P1 > P2 > P3 > P4 > P5 (token_budget.py:14-33)

input.context_token_budget: REDACTED small value for the fixture, e.g. 500 (WorkflowNode.context_token_budget)

expected.processing_order: P0, P1, P2, P3, P4 — strictly by PRIORITY_ORDER, not by size or arrival order
expected.p0_p1_p2_behavior: included as-is if they fit in remaining budget; otherwise truncated to whatever budget remains (never below MIN_COMPRESSED_TOKENS=40) — never dropped entirely
expected.p3_p4_p5_behavior: included whole if they fit; otherwise dropped entirely (never partially truncated) — token_budget.py:171-186
expected.over_budget_flag: TokenBudgetResult.over_budget == (raw_estimated_tokens > context_token_budget) — informational only, does not block or raise
expected.dropped_labels_reported: TokenBudgetResult.dropped_labels lists every block priority P3-P5 that didn't fit, surfaced in AgentRun.token_budget_report.blocks[*].included=false
expected.hard_stop_behavior: NONE — the call to the provider proceeds regardless of over_budget; TokenBudgetService never raises or refuses to build a result
expected.spend_limit_enforcement: ABSENT — no mechanism in this codebase compares AgentRun.cost or any running total against a ceiling and blocks further generation. Confirmed by grep across ai_generation.py, loop_engine.py, and the agent_runs/implementation_runs/test_runs/pr_review_runs routes for cost-limit/spend-limit logic — none found.
expected.recommendation: See baseline doc section 12, item 8 — a spend-limit check is a pure addition for Phase 01+, not a modification of existing behavior, and should default OFF behind a feature flag until evaluated.
